Chips.Label: GM filters
Chips.MetOnlyTip: Hide NPCs the party hasn't met
Chips.CastTip: Only actors marked as Cast by the module named in the Cast flag scopes setting
Chips.SelectTip: Tick several cards to change them together

Sort.Name: A to Z
Sort.NameTip: Sorted A to Z. Click for most recently met first.
Sort.RecentTip: Sorted by who was met most recently. Click for A to Z.

Empty.GMMetOnly: Nobody marked as met yet. Turn off Met only to start, or select tokens and mark them.
Empty.Player: The party hasn't met anyone yet.

Side.Label: Groups
Side.SortTip: Drag a group to move it, or use Move up and Move down with the group open

Group.Name: Name
Group.RenameTip: Rename the group for everyone in it
Group.MergeAsk: There's already a group called {to}. Put everyone in {from} into it?
Group.ArchiveTip: Archive the {n} people in this group
Group.ArchiveTipHidden: Archive the {n} people in this group ({hidden} of them hidden by your filters)
Group.ArchiveAsk: Archive the {n} people in {name}? Their attitudes and notes are kept, and you can bring them back.
Group.BringBackTip: Bring back this group's archived people
Group.RemoveTip: Take the group off the list; its people keep their records
Group.RemoveAskPeople: Remove the group {name}? The {n} people in it keep their records, with no group.
Group.AttitudeTip: The attitude members whose own attitude isn't set take: the group's own, or a Campaign Trackers reputation's

GroupDialog.Title: Group attitude: {name}
GroupDialog.Hint: Members whose own attitude is Not set take this one. A member with an attitude of their own keeps it.
GroupDialog.TierHint: While the group follows a reputation, its current tier gives the attitude (the group's own is used when the reputation can't be read). Each tier starts with a guess by its place; change any of them.
GroupDialog.NoTrackers: With PF2e Campaign Trackers on, a group can also follow one of its reputations.

Unmet.Heading: Not met yet ({n})
Unmet.More: {n} more not shown. Search to narrow the list.

Card.PlayersSeeTip: What the players see. Use this when someone hides how they feel.
Card.NoPerCharacter: , and none of the per-character attitudes
Card.AnnounceTip: Post what the players see of this NPC to chat
Card.BlurbPlaceholder: One line the players see: who they are, where the party met them
Card.KnownAsTip: The name players see. Empty: the prototype token name.
Card.RevealTip: Show players the actor's real name
Card.PortraitFieldTip: The image players see. Empty: the actor image; if that is art shipped with the system, a Paizo content or token module, or Foundry's own icons, the prototype token image instead; if that is shipped art too, a silhouette when the module's setting asks for one, else that art.
Card.ArchiveTip: Out of the story for now: move to Archived, attitude and notes kept
Card.BringBackTip: Bring them back into the lists
Card.PortraitTip: Open the sheet. Drag onto a group in the list, or use the Group menu under Edit.

Scene.ClearTip: Go back to the stored attitudes

History.Label: History
History.WhyPlaceholder: A few words, if you like

Notes.Heading: Party notes
Notes.Placeholder: Add a note for the party
Notes.NoGM: A GM has to be logged in to save notes.

Refused.long: A note can be at most {len} characters.
Refused.count: This person already has {max} notes, the most they hold. Remove some first.
Refused.chars: This person's notes are full ({chars} characters in all). Remove some first.
Refused.fast: One note at a time, please. Try again in a moment.

Disposition.Title: Token disposition
Disposition.One: {name} has a token on this scene whose disposition isn't {label}. Set it to {label}?
Disposition.Many: {name} has {n} tokens on this scene whose disposition isn't {label}. Set them to {label}?

Impression.Title: Make an Impression
Impression.ButtonTip: Roll the system's Make an Impression against this NPC's Will DC; the GM applies the result
Impression.Reminder: After at least a minute of conversation, outside an encounter. The target has to hear and understand the character.
Impression.Targets: Targets (up to {n}; {penalty} with more than one)
Impression.NotAllowed: The GM hasn't let players Make an Impression from the People window.
Impression.NoAction: The PF2e system's Make an Impression action wasn't found; this may need a module update.
Impression.NoCharacter: There's no character to roll for.
Impression.NoDC: has no Will DC to roll against.
Impression.AppliedElsewhere: applied already (from this roll or its reroll)

Notice.SelectFirst: Select one or more NPC tokens first.
Notice.SelectedGone: The selected tokens' actors no longer exist in the sidebar.
Notice.MarkedSkipped: Marked {n} as met. Skipped {skipped} whose actor no longer exists.
Notice.AnnounceOff: Announcements are turned off in this module's settings.
Notice.Undone: {user} changed the People record of {name}; it was put back. Only a GM changes these records.

Announce.Name: Announce to
Announce.Hint: Who the Announce button on a card posts to. Nothing is posted unless the GM presses it.

ImpressionPlayers.Name: Players can Make an Impression
ImpressionPlayers.Hint: Players get a Make an Impression button on their own cards, rolling for a character they own. The GM still applies every result.

StockPortrait.Name: When the only art is shipped art
StockPortrait.Hint: What players see for an NPC whose actor and token images are both art shipped with the system, a Paizo module or Foundry (which can give away what the creature is), until a portrait is set.

CastScopes.Name: Cast flag scopes
CastScopes.Hint: Comma-separated module ids. An actor with flags.<id>.cast set counts as Cast for the Cast filter. The Cast chip shows only when this has an id.
